initiative.title: Psionic: native decision models and learning pipelines in Coax
initiative.body: Build Psionic from scratch with a runnable book and shared Coax libraries. Owner priority: complete native Elephant and Mammoth support early, independent of the pedagogical training order. Then grow nanochat-compatible inference, reproducible pretraining, SFT, reward training, decision-model post-training and explicit distributed execution. M0 is already shipped; future tasks are open.

milestones.title: Shared numerical and artifact foundations
milestones.body: Extend the completed scalar trainer with reusable storage, dense operations and pinned model contracts. These foundations serve inference and learning.

milestones.title: Elephant and Mammoth first
milestones.body: Urgent delivery path: native Coax Qwen3.5 hybrid execution, faithful decision prompts, independent suffix forks and slot readout. Elephant first, Mammoth immediately after; neither waits for autodiff or nanochat training.

milestones.title: Useful native device execution
milestones.body: Develop the missing Coax compute subset and a measured Metal backend alongside the decision engine. Qualify exact original-weight profiles before separate quantized profiles.

milestones.title: Reusable learning and nanochat
milestones.body: Build autodiff and a tiny complete decoder, then reproduce the pinned nanochat architecture, tokenization, optimizer and resumable pretraining in Coax.

milestones.title: Post-training and evaluation
milestones.body: Add masked SFT, the pinned nanochat reward-training recipe, and decision-model training only after the relevant gradients, data and evaluation paths work.

milestones.title: Serving, multimodality and scale
milestones.body: Versioned System One integration, later vision, and explicit same-node distributed training. Each capability needs its own end-to-end evidence.

tasks.body:
Completed baseline, commit 38eab9b9fe0326c333325ff5a05df400de1dd0e2. Shared scalar library, book chapter, output publication and native overlap boundary. Retain it as a regression, not a claim of tensor or GPU support.
